item.description: Following the resignation announcement of Land and Agricultural Development Bank of South Africa(Land Bank) Chief Executive Officer Themba Rikhotso on 9 February, the Board of Directors has moved swiftly to ensure stability.

item.title: FMD | Lactalis SA backs producers amid new outbreaks
item.description: Lactalis South Africa will continue to collect milk from producers regardless of their foot-and-mouth disease status, the company has said in a letter to its producers in response to recent outbreaks of the disease in the Western Cape.

item.title: NSPCA welcomes conviction in Dealesville pig neglect case
item.description: The National Council of SPCAs (NSPCA)has welcomed the guilty verdict and sentencing in a harrowing animal cruelty case involving the severe neglect of pigs in Dealesville in the Free State.

item.title: Different rules for cattle and chickens – poultry sector demands answers on vaccine double standards
item.description: The poultry industry is demanding that government explain the clearly different handling of vaccination programmes for poultry and cattle.

item.title: FMD | Vaccine shipment expected by Friday
item.description: The first 1 million doses of the Biogénesis Bagó vaccine against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) are expected to arrive in South Africa by the end of this week.

item.title: 130 goats and kilometres of fencing swept away after Jansenville cloudburst
item.description: A farmer from Jansenville lost 130 Angora goats, 10 Boer goats and several kilometres of wire fencing when 110mm of rain fell on his farm within an hour.

item.title: We have a group of ageing farmers; we need young ones – KZN MEC
item.description: The KwaZulu-Natal MEC for Agriculture and Rural Development, Thembeni kaMadlopha-Mthethwa, has called on young South Africans to consider agriculture as their career of choice, citing the urgent need to rejuvenate the sector’s ageing workforce.
